name: apple-fm-copilot-provider
displayName: Apple Foundation Models for Copilot Chat
description: Use Apple's on-device Foundation Model (Apple Intelligence) as a model in VS Code Copilot Chat. Private, offline, free.

appleFm.bridgePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `fm-bridge` binary. Leave empty to use the bundled `bin/fm-bridge` (or `swift/.build/release/fm-bridge` in a dev checkout).

appleFm.systemPrompt.default: You are a concise, accurate coding assistant. Answer directly. Use Markdown and fenced code blocks.
appleFm.systemPrompt.description: Instructions given to the model on every request. Keep it short: they count against the model's small context window (4096 tokens on-device).

appleFm.maxInputTokens.markdownDescription: Cap on prompt tokens. `0` (default) uses the whole context window minus `#appleFm.maxOutputTokens#` (3096 tokens on the 4096-token on-device model). Prompts are measured with the model's own tokenizer and trimmed only when they don't fit.

appleFm.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Tokens always kept free for the reply. Short prompts leave the reply all remaining room in the window; long prompts are trimmed to keep at least this much.

scripts.package: npm run build:swift && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --target darwin-arm64 -o apple-fm-copilot-provider.vsix
